items.title_en: Why Do Indians Hang Lemon and Chilies Outside Shops? It's More Than Just Nazar
items.title_zh: 为什么印度人在商店外挂柠檬和辣椒？这不仅仅是纳扎尔
items.summary_en: For Indians, this age-old practice offers a curious blend of comfort, cultural identity, and hope something that survives not because it must, but because it still makes sense.
items.summary_zh: 对于印度人来说，这种古老的习俗提供了一种奇怪的融合，融合了舒适、文化认同和希望，一些东西能够生存下来，不是因为它必须存在，而是因为它仍然有意义。
